mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, issue_date, issue_no, headline, predicted_end, delay_days, created_at FROM daily_issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY issue_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND issue_date = #{issueDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_issue (project_id, issue_date, issue_no, headline, predicted_end, delay_days, snapshot) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{issueDate}, #{issueNo}, #{headline}, #{predictedEnd}, #{delayDays}, #{snapshot}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE issue_no = VALUES(issue_no), headline = VALUES(headline), predicted_end = VALUES(predicted_end), delay_days = VALUES(delay_days), snapshot = VALUES(snapshot)
